_comment: IndentSize is off because this checker cannot tell indentation from
alignment, and everything it flagged here was alignment. Two shapes, both
deliberate and both wanted: a continuation line aligned under the pipeline
it belongs to (scripts/seed-validation-env.sh:47, scripts/validate.sh:166),
and the three-space continuation of a numbered list item in Markdown
(docs/adr/*.md). The second is not a matter of taste — markdownlint
requires those three spaces, so .editorconfig's indent_size of 2 and
markdownlint-cli2 cannot both be satisfied, and markdownlint is the one
that is right about Markdown. 77 findings, no defects among them.
Nothing else is disabled, and one directory is excluded (below).
Trailing whitespace, final newline, charset, line
endings and indent_style (tabs in the Makefile and *.alloy, spaces
elsewhere) are all still enforced, which is the part that catches real
damage. Verified: adding a trailing space to a script fails this checker.
This file is new because the checker had never actually run. CI's
EditorConfig step was editorconfig-checker/action-editorconfig-checker@v2,
which downloads the binary and adds it to PATH and never invokes it — a
green step that checked nothing, for as long as it has been there. See #68.
stacks/sensor/zeek/ja4/ is EXCLUDED, and that is the one exclusion. It is
FoxIO's ja4-zeek-scripts vendored byte-for-byte (ADR-0069): upstream has
trailing spaces and missing final newlines, and editing them would make
every re-vendor's diff partly ours and break scripts/vendor-ja4.sh --check,
which compares the directory to upstream exactly. Our own files in it
(NOTICE, VENDORED) are plain text the checker would pass anyway.
